write_tool_schemas.name: hmc_file_x2e_patch
write_tool_schemas.description: Apply small exact replacements to a complete authorized workspace file (source and result up to 1 MiB UTF-8; each replacement up to 256 KiB). Prefer small separate patches within tool-call argument limits. Optional expectedDigest accepts sha256:hex or the same 64 hex digits and rejects stale content. Access files in the authorized workspace. When the user has enabled full access, absolute paths accessible to the current OS account are also allowed. Host protections and path checks still apply.

write_tool_schemas.name: hmc_file_x2e_write
write_tool_schemas.description: Write UTF-8 text to one explicitly approved file in the workspace. Supply expectedDigest from the latest workspace read (null for a new file). The host checks the source version before and after approval; a conflict requires a fresh read. Access files in the authorized workspace. When the user has enabled full access, absolute paths accessible to the current OS account are also allowed. Host protections and path checks still apply.

public_output_by_round.15: 对 `metadataDigest` 失败的那条断言，其来源是 `readGitMetadata`。`index` 和 `FETCH_HEAD` 已经被标记为 volatile，因此只比较存在性；但 `git status` 会重写 `.git/index`，同时也会重写属于非 volatile 的其他条目。我先确认具体哪个条目的指纹发生翻转。
